entries.title: Code Vein
entries.definitive_edition: Code Vein Digital Deluxe Edition / Season Pass on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with all Season Pass DLC.

primary.why: The Windows PC Digital Deluxe route is the best main-play version because it includes the full game and Season Pass content while preserving PC settings and capture flexibility. The Season Pass/DLC route covers Hellfire Knight, Frozen Empress, Lord of Thunder, new bosses, weapons, Blood Veils, blood codes, and related character-creation/partner costume content; there is no sourced platform-exclusive story content on PS4 or Xbox One.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Code Vein Digital Deluxe Edition or the Windows PC base game plus Season Pass/DLC on Steam. Install Hellfire Knight, Frozen Empress, and Lord of Thunder before a completion run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC release with Digital Deluxe/Season Pass DLC support.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete DLC route with PC settings and capture flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release with Digital Deluxe/Season Pass route available.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route exists, but no sourced exclusive content over the Windows PC Digital Deluxe route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release with Digital Deluxe/Season Pass route available.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route exists, but no sourced exclusive content over the Windows PC Digital Deluxe route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows PC route can include the Season Pass DLC, so the complete-content and fidelity-first recommendation align.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later remaster is documented; completeness depends on installing the Season Pass DLC packs.

entries.title: Code Vein II
entries.definitive_edition: Code Vein II Ultimate Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Ultimate Edition entitlement and future Mask of Idris expansion access.

primary.why: The Windows PC Ultimate Edition is the best archival pick because it is the highest-fidelity/capture-friendly route and includes the base game, Custom Outfit Pack, Mask of Idris expansion entitlement, Code Vein character costume set, and digital mini artbook/soundtrack. The main caveat is timing: Mask of Idris will be available by January 2027, so a truly complete story-content run should wait until that expansion unlocks.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Code Vein II Ultimate Edition on Steam for Windows PC. Play the base game natively now if desired, but for a final complete archive run, wait until the Mask of Idris expansion is available and installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Steam editions, graphics settings, and Ultimate Edition DLC entitlement.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity/capture route and most complete edition entitlement, with Mask of Idris included when available.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release with Standard, Deluxe, Ultimate, and Collector edition routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete entitlement route exists, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC Ultimate Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release with Standard, Deluxe, Ultimate, and Collector edition routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete entitlement route exists, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC Ultimate Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The fidelity-first platform is Windows PC, but full completeness is time-gated because the Ultimate/Deluxe story expansion Mask of Idris is documented as available by January 2027.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented. Do not treat the base launch build as complete if Sami wants the Mask of Idris story expansion included in the same archive run.
